name: How long does cabinet refinishing typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does cabinet refinishing typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a cabinet refinishing project varies based on the size of your kitchen, the number of cabinets, and the complexity of the desired finish. Generally, a typical kitchen cabinet refinishing project can take anywhere from 3 to 7 days from preparation to final coat application. We will provide a more precise timeline after assessing your specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cabinet refinishing usually takes 3 to 7 days, depending on kitchen size and project complexity.
